summary: Food Culture Inc., a Delaware corporation quoted on OTC Link under FCUL and not registered under Section 12, voluntarily filed a Form 8-K Item 8.01 on September 8, 2026, submitting an EDGAR company-information update reflecting its current legal name, principal executive office, security identifiers, capitalization and contact details. The filing discloses 45,089,630 common shares outstanding as of September 4, 2026, 500,000,000 authorized shares, a new CUSIP 38119W305 superseding 38119W206, and the appointment of independent director Alena Ivanova effective September 1, 2026. No transaction, consideration, board recommendation or advisor is stated; the report expressly disclaims being an offer, solicitation or investment recommendation, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle arise beyond name and identifier record updates.
